name: sidebar
purpose: Helps users move between views or sections. Composable application sidebar with optional header and footer regions; navigation content scrolls inside a built-in `ScrollArea`. It also owns **the rail gesture** — sizing the sidebar by dragging its trailing edge, and collapsing it out of the layout entirely. That belongs here rather than in each shell: the interaction is not a small one (a pointer drag that crosses the collapse boundary continuously, a keyboard equivalent, token-derived bounds, a phase-aware transition, and an affordance that brings a collapsed rail back), and every app that has a sidebar wants the same one. Two shells re-implementing it is how the two drift apart. Both halves are **opt-in and independent**: `resizable` adds the drag, `collapsible` adds the collapse trigger and the edge affordance. With neither set the component renders exactly as it always has, with the host owning the width — every existing consumer is unaffected.
useWhen: The persistent navigation column of an app shell, with an optional header (brand, workspace switcher) and footer (profile, settings) around a scrolling `Menu`.
The user should be able to resize the rail by dragging its trailing edge (`resizable`) or take it out of the layout and bring it back (`collapsible`).
The rail's size or collapsed state must survive navigation or reloads — bind `v-model:width` and `v-model:collapsed` and persist them in the app.
avoidWhen: Adjacent work areas the reader resizes (editor beside a preview, a terminal under it) → use `resizable`.
Horizontal top-level navigation with dropdown panels → use `navigation-menu`.
A temporary panel that slides over the page → use `drawer`.
related: menu` — the navigation rows, groups and drill levels that go in the sidebar's default slot.
resizable` — draggable splits between content regions; the sidebar's rail gesture is for navigation only.
global-header` — the top bar that usually sits above the sidebar in an app shell.
platform-shell` — the console layout template that composes the header, the sidebar and the page.
bestPractices: Put a `Menu` with `role="presentation"` in the default slot; the sidebar already renders the `nav` landmark and its `aria-label` (default `'Sidebar'`) names the region.
Use `Menu.Group` for new navigation — `SidebarGroup` still works but is superseded.
Without `resizable` or `collapsible`, size the rail with a width class on the root; with either set, the sidebar owns the width and clamps it between `min-width-token` and `max-width-token`.
When the sidebar is revealed after mount (for example leaving a mobile layout where it was hidden), call the exposed `measure()` so the rail does not keep a zero width.
Keep the profile block in the `footer` slot; with `collapsible`, the collapse trigger renders in the same footer row.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the navigation landmark. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Sidebar`).

props.name: resizable
props.doc: Adds the drag handle on the trailing edge; dragging past the minimum collapses the rail.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Adds the collapse trigger at the bottom of the rail and the edge affordance that brings a collapsed rail back.

props.name: minWidthToken
props.doc: Theme container token the sized width is clamped up to, read off the document at runtime.

props.name: maxWidthToken
props.doc: Theme container token the sized width is clamped down to, read off the document at runtime.

props.name: collapseAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the collapse trigger. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Collapse sidebar`).

props.name: expandAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the control and the grab bar that bring a collapsed rail back. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Expand sidebar`).

props.name: resizeAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the drag handle separator. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Resize sidebar`).

events.name: update:collapsed
events.notes: v-model:collapsed` — the rail entered or left the layout, by the trigger, the drag crossing the snap boundary, the keyboard nudge, or a double-click on the handle.

events.name: update:width
events.notes: v-model:width` — the sized width in px, already clamped to the token bounds. Emitted continuously during a drag.

slots.name: footer
slots.notes: Named slot. The collapse trigger renders after this content in the same row, under one full-width separator, so a profile block and the trigger read as one footer.
